explanation: The patch registers debug stack maps for linear-memory traps, but the x64 i64 load path does not register its faulting range. Debug compilation of the witness therefore finds an out-of-bounds trap without a stack map.
verification: The final ASan shell rebuild succeeded with zero compiler warnings. The witness exits 1 with MOZ_CRASH(wasm::CheckStackMapsForTraps: trapping instruction lacks a stackmap) and an ASan fatal signal. Restoring the omitted registration made the source patch match golden.diff and the same witness exited 0 after an ASan shell rebuild.
